releaseNotes: PR-4a of the 2026-08 graph-consolidation audit's thin-domain rebalancing: domain.research's flagship workflow, research-backed-spec, produces the Go/Pivot/Kill verdict that gates all downstream design/build spend, but had no owned knowledge file — the judgment layer existed only as ~200 lines of post-hoc validator error-message logic in check-research-evidence.ts. Added knowledge/research/go-pivot-or-kill.md, restating the validator's actual enforced criteria (the Category Revenue Reality bar, the verdict table contract, the founder-only decider rule, what Kill/Pivot mean, and when the verdict becomes mandatory) as a real reference an agent loads and reasons from before writing strategy/RESEARCH.md, rather than inventing new criteria.

domain.product has 5 knowledge files but 2 of its 4 routeWhen-promised concerns (core loop, V1-vs-later scope) went unanswered for any product outside the 4 shipped archetypes — SKILL.md told agents to improvise instead. Added knowledge/product/core-loop-and-v1-scope.md, generalizing the shared method the 4 archetype files already use (confirm-the-shape AskUserQuestion, a named core-systems list with exactly one system marked as the loop, a V1-vs-later cut, and threading into 11-star/analytics/security/revenue) into a fifth, non-archetype lane.

Both files are registered in catalog/references.ts under their domains with load-when triggers scoped to the actual gap (writing the Go/Pivot/Kill verdict; a product that doesn't match a shipped archetype).
